g.text: SD05 - Fall and return to start
One serialized application loop. GameView is JavaFxGameView or CliView. Voice service exists only for
GUI. State lifeline denotes the current PlayerState object at each tick.
ActiveState checks position throughout movement substeps.
Cancel owned timed commands and release their
Cancel pending results and clear the frozen
Fall event captured before cleanup may contain old inputs. The next STATE_CHANGED snapshot reflects
NEXT TICK - return to the start. No previous movement is restored.
GUI redraws the fresh snapshot. Live CLI periodic redraw is throttled. Plain CLI omits periodic
ACTIVE at start, zero velocity, held={}
GameModel then publishes STATE_CHANGED. Lifecycle events refresh both views. Old decisions cannot match
the fresh epoch. "Again" has no remembered movement. Every fall returns to Level.start(). No checkpoints
